x5gtqjxd.baseName: Christmas Tree World 5ft Pre-Lit Snowy Alpine - Warm White Lights
x5gtqjxd.variantName: Christmas Tree World 5ft Pre-Lit Snowy Alpine - Warm White Lights
x5gtqjxd.sourceDescription: This hugely popular snow-covered Christmas tree range is a real head turner! Our customers love how closely the Pre-lit Snowy Alpine replicates the freshly cut, snowy trees from Christmas films. Combining a flocked and frosted mix of traditional PVC and expertly moulded PE branch tips, you get a realistic Christmas tree that doesn't scrimp on essential snowy features. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. Product Features • Size: 5ft • Pre-Lit with 180 Professionally strung warm white multi function LEDS • Number of Branch Tips: 375 flocked PE/PVC branch tips • Tree Width: 76cm diameter • Foliage colour: Heavily snow flocked dark green • Realistic look: A mix of ultra-realistic plastic moulded tips, with traditional PVC tips to fill out any gaps • Easy assembly: Attached Hinged Branches • Sturdy base: Folding metal stand with plastic tips to prevent scratching • Indoor use only: Tree and snow flock must be kept dry • Height measured from the floor • Eligible for European shipping • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom

t3wqep83.baseName: Christow Pre-Lit White Birch Christmas Tree – 6ft
t3wqep83.variantName: Christow Pre-Lit White Birch Christmas Tree – 6ft
t3wqep83.sourceDescription: Create a stunning centrepiece at Christmas with this White Birch Tree With Lights from Christow. Designed with flexible branches and illuminated by warm white LEDs, it’s a stylish alternative to a traditional Christmas tree. This 6ft version is designed for a festive seasonal display. • Warm White LEDs: The branches of the tree are decorated with warm white LEDs to add a warm, welcoming glow to your home at Christmas. • 5m Power Cable: The tree is powered by a BS IP44 mains plug which is suitable for plugging into an indoor socket. • Attachable Square Base: An attachable base is included with the tree, enabling you to stand it securely upright inside or outside your home. • Ground Stakes Included: The tree also includes a set of U-shaped ground stakes. Specifications: • Brand: Christow • Dimensions: H180cm x W70cm x D70cm • Colour: White • Material: PVC • Lights: Pre-lit • Tree shape: Small • Weight: 1.34kg For decorative use only. Not a toy. Ensure the tree is securely assembled and positioned on a stable surface. Keep away from heat and naked flames. Read and follow all instructions and safety warnings before use. Wilton Bradley Ltd, 8 Wentworth Road, Heathfield Industrial Estate, Newton Abbot, Devon, TQ12 6TL

nr3nxjsj.variantName: Christmas Tree World 8ft Outdoor Ultra Slim Mixed Pine Christmas Tree
nr3nxjsj.sourceDescription: When you choose the Outdoor Ultra Slim Mixed Pine tree, you get the best of our realistic, slim Christmas trees - only these ones are weather-resistant. Incorporating PE plastic-moulded branch tips with traditional high-quality PVC branches, our Outdoor Ultra Slim Mixed Pines provide full, gap-free foliage that suit decorations wonderfully! They're also one of our fastest trees to erect, giving you extra time to relax with the family. You'll also be pleased to find that this 8ft outdoor Christmas tree includes a mixture of hinged and attached/fold-down branches, making the branches easy to bend into shape. Picture shows 7ft tree in our range. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. Product Features • Size: 8ft • Number of Branch Tips: 1706 PE/PVC branch tips • Tree Width: 89cm diameter • Slim Profile: Great choice for when space is limited • Foliage colour: Realistic dark green • Realistic look: Ultra realistic Plastic moulded tips and traditional PVC tips to fill out any gaps • Easy assembly: Attached Hinged Branches • Sturdy base: Heavy-duty outdoor stand with 8 pegs • Fire-resistant: Fire retardancy certified • Outdoor Use: Rust treated and Galvanised metal parts • Height measured from the floor • Eligible for European shipping • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom
